title: An experimental assembly for precise measurement of thermal accommodation coefficients (Trott et al.)
supports: Parallel-plate gas-gap heat-flux method (pressure dependence) gives TAC on surfaces incl. silicon: untreated ~0.95 Ar, ~0.85 N2, ~0.45 He; in-situ Ar-plasma clean lowers He by up to ~0.10 (via search snippet)

title: Determination of thermal accommodation coefficients from heat transfer measurements
supports: For most surfaces TAC ~0.95 Ar, 0.85 N2, 0.45 He; roughness has only slight effect, contamination matters more (Ar plasma lowers He TAC by up to 0.10) (via search snippet)

title: Measurement of the thermal accommodation coefficient of helium on a crystalline silicon surface at low temperatures (Franke et al.)
